name: Radiography Testing (X-Ray & Gamma Ray)
shortDescription: Uses X-Ray or Gamma Ray sources to view internal structure and detect flaws with a permanent record.
introduction: Radiographic Testing (RT) uses X-Ray or Gamma Ray (Ir-192) sources to view and assess the internal structure of an asset. RT is sensitive to corrosion, changes in thickness, voids, cracks and material density changes, and can detect both surface and sub-surface defects with minimum surface preparation.
whyChooseUs: Largest fleet of Pipeline X-Ray Crawlers in Bangladesh
Strict health & safety compliance under BAERA licence
Fast turnaround with digital and film radiography options

workingProcess.description: Radiation zone marked and cleared per BAERA safety protocol.

workingProcess.title: Source/Film Placement
workingProcess.description: Test-part placed between radiation source and film/detector.

workingProcess.title: Exposure
workingProcess.description: Controlled exposure captures material density and thickness variations.

workingProcess.title: Film/Digital Processing
workingProcess.description: Radiograph developed or digitally rendered for evaluation.

workingProcess.title: Interpretation & Reporting
workingProcess.description: Certified interpreter evaluates against applicable code and issues report.

name: Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
shortDescription: Detects surface and sub-surface discontinuities, corrosion and cracks using ultrasonic waves.
introduction: Conventional Ultrasonic Testing (UT) inspection is a commonly-used NDT technique that measures the propagation of mechanical vibrations through a material to examine properties, measure thickness and detect discontinuities including corrosion, erosion, flaws and cracks.
whyChooseUs: Modern digital flaw detectors (Olympus, Sonatest, Modsonic)
Accurate readings on discontinuity size and shape

workingProcess.title: Surface Preparation
workingProcess.description: Test surface cleaned and couplant applied.

workingProcess.title: Probe Calibration
workingProcess.description: Flaw detector calibrated against reference block.

workingProcess.title: Scanning
workingProcess.description: Probe scanned across the test area per procedure.

workingProcess.title: Reporting
workingProcess.description: Indications recorded and evaluated against acceptance criteria.

name: Ultrasonic Thickness Gauging (UTG)
shortDescription: Accurate wall-thickness measurement for corrosion monitoring on pipes, plates and vessels.
introduction: UTG accurately measures remaining wall thickness on pipes, plates and vessels, allowing early detection of corrosion or erosion before it becomes critical.

workingProcess.title: Grid Marking
workingProcess.description: Measurement grid marked on the component.

workingProcess.title: Gauge Calibration
workingProcess.description: Thickness gauge calibrated on a known reference.

workingProcess.title: Measurement
workingProcess.description: Readings taken at each grid point and logged.

name: Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI)
shortDescription: Quick, cost-effective method to detect surface and near-surface discontinuities.
introduction: In MPI, the ferromagnetic material is magnetized and finely-milled iron particles coated with a dye pigment are applied. Particles cluster over discontinuities, making them visible under proper lighting.
whyChooseUs: Portable electromagnetic yokes for field work

workingProcess.description: Test area cleaned of oil, rust and debris.

workingProcess.title: Magnetization
workingProcess.description: Yoke or prod applied to magnetize the material.

workingProcess.title: Particle Application
workingProcess.description: Magnetic ink or dry powder applied.

workingProcess.title: Evaluation
workingProcess.description: Indications inspected under adequate lighting.

name: Dye Penetrant Testing (DPT)
shortDescription: Low-cost method for finding surface-breaking discontinuities on smooth, nonporous surfaces.
introduction: DPT is a non-destructive method for finding surface-breaking discontinuities on relatively smooth, nonporous surfaces — low-cost and effective on complex geometries without disassembly.

workingProcess.title: Cleaning
workingProcess.description: Surface cleaned and dried.

workingProcess.title: Penetrant Application
workingProcess.description: Penetrant applied and given dwell time.

workingProcess.title: Excess Removal & Developer
workingProcess.description: Excess penetrant removed, developer applied.

workingProcess.title: Inspection
workingProcess.description: Indications evaluated under proper lighting.

shortDescription: Computer-controlled ultrasonic beam array for fast, highly efficient weld defect detection.
introduction: PAUT uses computer-controlled, electronically-steered ultrasonic beam arrays, capturing hundreds of signals at once for improved efficiency, permanent records, and reduced false alarms — also used for corrosion mapping.

name: Time of Flight Diffraction (TOFD)
shortDescription: Advanced ultrasonic method to detect and size planar defects and cracks in welds.
introduction: TOFD detects planar defects and cracks not perpendicular to the measured surface, with high probability of detection (POD) improving risk reduction and sizing accuracy.

introduction: LRUT remotely analyzes assets for corrosion and flaws over long distances without direct contact — ideal for rapidly inspecting pipelines and piping systems with minimal insulation removal.
